newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China 1996 profit at 8.2 bln yuan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China 1996 profit at 8.2 bln yuan - paper.

text.p: The Bank of China earned 8.2 billion yuan ($988 million) on income of 206.7 billion yuan ($24.91 billion) from its domestic operations last year, the Financial News said on Monday.
The Bank of China, one of the nation's four main state-run banks, had assets of 1.8199 trillion yuan as of the end of last year, the newspaper said without giving any figures for 1995.
An official at the Bank of China told Reuters that the profit figure was for domestic operations after tax.

The Bank of China reported pre-tax profits of 10.5 billion yuan for 1995, giving it the largest profit total of all state-run commercial banks. It was unclear whether the 1995 figure included operations outside the country, however.
The Financial News, which is published by the central bank, said that the Bank of China performed relatively well in all of its key areas of business and recorded a year of stable growth.

The Bank of China was once known as the nation's specialised foreign exchange bank. While it no longer has a monopoly in foreign exchange, it is still one of the stronger banks in that segment of the market.
The bank's domestic deposits totalled 486.4 billion yuan, while foreign currency deposits were $29.3 billion at the end of last year, the newspaper said.
Domestic loans outstanding were 475.0 billion yuan, while foreign currency loans were $34.1 billion.
The bank said that 80 percent of its new loans extended during the year were made to medium and large state enterprises.
The newspaper said Bank of China made $119.3 billion worth of foreign exchange settlements, largely for trade-related purposes.
It said the bank had issued a total of 4.3 million Great Wall credit cards with credit card transactions valued at 189.6 billion yuan during the year.
The newspaper said the bank's assets outside the country were $131.0 billion, with non-China operations showing a rise of 17.2 percent in pre-tax profits.
It said that the bank repaid 8.6 billion worth of loans extended from the central bank during the year.
Bank of China bought 5.5 billion yuan worth of state financial paper during the year and was underwriter for 11.5 billion yuan worth of government debt.
